_comment: THE DECLARATION FILE FOR NUMBERED BROWSER SUITES.
There is ONE list of what the release gate runs: BROWSER_SUITES in
scripts/run-platform-tests.sh. This file is not a second copy of it. It is
the place a suite that deliberately does NOT run in that gate is declared,
with the reason, so that 'it is not in the runner' is always either a
recorded decision or a failure -- never an oversight nobody can see.
scripts/verify-browser-suite-registry.mjs enforces it: every numbered file
in scripts/browser-verification/ must be in BROWSER_SUITES or listed here.
Adding a suite and forgetting the runner now fails the gate on the commit
that adds it, which is the only moment anyone still remembers why.
Convergence Step 7 found twenty-seven fixture-operations suites outside the
runner and twelve of them broken. This file exists so that cannot recur
silently. A reason here is a commitment, not a dismissal.

exempt.00-harness-validation: Tests the harness, not the product -- it asserts that sign-in, viewports and the mail catcher behave, which is the precondition for every other suite rather than a claim about Ovalball. Run it by hand when the harness is changed.

Its status is UNVERIFIED; it is declared here rather than wired in, because wiring an unverified suite into the gate would make the gate's colour meaningless.

exempt.44-canonical-memberships: MESSAGING/IDENTITY PROGRAMME, NOT YET RECONCILED. Measured at Step 8: aborts after 2 assertions on a UI click timeout. Its scope spans memberships, roles AND family relationships, so it is only partly covered by Step 8's SQL estate and no honest single disposition was available without family-domain work Step 8 does not own. Status UNVERIFIED; the measurement is recorded so the next reader starts from evidence.
exempt.45-capability-foundation: SUPERSEDED by the SQL estate, which runs in the canonical gate and asserts the same foundation far more thoroughly: capability_precedence_truth_table.sql (50 assertions over the full rule 0-8 order), capability_scope_isolation.sql (22) and step8_operational_access.sql (69). Measured at Step 8: this suite aborts after 4 assertions waiting for a club allow that the current screen no longer renders the way it expects. The authority it guarded is guarded; the browser journey it walked no longer exists.
exempt.46-family-authority: FAMILY DOMAIN, NOT YET RECONCILED. Measured at Step 8: 13 of 14 assertions pass; F1 (a Site Admin seeing a person's family relationships) fails with HTTP 200. That is a real single finding in a domain Step 8 does not own -- family relationships are a relationship, not an administrative role shortcut -- so it is recorded rather than repaired here. Status UNVERIFIED.
exempt.51-role-negative-smoke: SUPERSEDED by role_assignment_ceilings.sql (28 assertions, in the canonical gate, covering exactly which role each level may and may not give) and by 48-club-access-boundary's persona refusals. Measured at Step 8: this suite hangs after one assertion and had to be killed at ten minutes. Its negatives are asserted; its replayed server actions are not a journey anybody walks.

exempt.57-safeguarding-authority: SAFEGUARDING DOMAIN, NOT YET RECONCILED. Step 8 preserved the safeguarding rules rather than rebuilding them (step8_operational_access.sql section J, 7 assertions) and deliberately did not mutate the persistent review world's pending nomination to make a suite green. Status UNVERIFIED.
